# Close CRM | Product Overview

Close CRM is a sales CRM centered on phone, SMS, email and outbound execution with built-in Chloe AI sales agents. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
